traits.name: Incubus Form
traits.text: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an **Incubus**, using that stat block instead of this one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

actions.name: Fiendish Touch
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.text: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. _Failure:_ 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. _Success:_ Half damage. _Failure or Success:_ The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.text: The succubus shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its Fly Speed is available only in its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. ## Tarrasque
